name: Yumei
source:
The mysterious girl that appears in [url=/c10490]Kei[/url]'s dreams and begins to speak to her as she comes closer to her father's house. Accompanied by swarms of pale blue butterflies that shine as if gathered from the light of the moon.

[Taken from [url=http://akaiitotranslation.com/info/characters/yumei.php]Zohar's site[/url].]
